scope: Five further native optimizations, isolated synthetic data only; earlier-phase results remain in their own reports
notes: One final SQLite run with 30 warm shuffled samples per scenario and mode; profiling disabled for primary measurements.
One final MariaDB run with five samples per variant: functional validation, exploratory performance only.
Focused benchmark is separate: 31 shuffled samples of five iterations, actual previous RenderData and DecodedReferences caches loaded.
Earlier development runs are excluded; results refer to the final policy that defers large unknown inputs only under cache pressure.
No uniform whole-page gain established: mixed medians and high variable tails. No HTTP, concurrency or production validation.
Timing-stripped effect profiles match in 16 comparisons per execution; new CSV preparation observations checked separately.
CSV payload_bytes is a conservative string-payload weight, not PHP heap usage. Entry/admission limits bound container counts; parsing allocations are transient.
Native decoder views are the measured production path; optional legacy wrappers can consume additional memory when explicitly requested.

helper_benchmark.scope: Pure helper operations against the actual previous caches; no whole-page performance claim
